purpose: Machine-readable roster and rule parameters for the fleet repository knowledge + agent-instruction standard, enforced by scripts/Check-RepoStandard.ps1. One authored agent contract (AGENTS.md) per repo; CLAUDE.md is an @-import adapter carrying the RepoWise-managed block; docs/ holds durable curated knowledge; RepoWise (one workspace at the fleet root) holds derived intelligence; the tracker named per repo is the only backlog authority.

workspace.note: Single RepoWise workspace over the fleet root. awesome-mcp-servers is deliberately NOT a member (external fork on an upstream PR branch); .demo-workspace is not a git repo.

excluded.name: awesome-mcp-servers
excluded.reason: External fork existing only for an upstream PR; standardization would pollute upstream-facing history.

excluded.reason: Not a git repository; demo production outputs.
